description: This file declares functions, macros, and includes necessary headers for managing WAN modes in a network device. It defines interfaces for initializing, setting, enabling, and cleaning up WAN modes, as well as handling sensing and conversion functions related to WAN configuration.

methods.name: system_module_loaded
methods.description: Checks if the system module is loaded.

methods.name: get_physical_type_by_reference
methods.description: Gets physical type from a reference string.

methods.name: get_physical_type
methods.description: Gets physical type from a WAN mode object.

methods.name: wan_mode_dm_set
methods.description: Sets the WAN mode with a specific operation mode.

methods.name: wan_mode_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a WAN mode.

methods.name: get_wan_mode
methods.description: Retrieves a WAN mode object by alias.

methods.name: get_current_wan_mode_str
methods.description: Returns the current WAN mode as a string.

methods.name: _update_sensing_policy
methods.description: Updates sensing policy based on events.

methods.name: wan_mode_convert_from_str
methods.description: Converts a string to a mode control structure based on IP version.
